shared_or_similar_visual_information: A horizontal colored line in a function diagram
mathematical_meanings: Left image: A fixed-y horizontal comparison line across the function graph. Right image: A constant function graph: the output remains c as the horizontal input varies.
Rationales: The orange stroke is one of several fixed-height guides cutting the parabola; the purple trace is explicitly labeled f(x)=c and is itself the function being plotted.
